result.detail: Firecrawl uses per-customer API keys (Bearer). Each customer creates own key in dashboard. Docs show no app review, verification, or install cap. Some requests work with no key. I found no OAuth app-approval flow in the docs I checked. I did not read every docs page, so this rests on the intro docs and the lack of any gate there.
result.quote: Add an [API key](https://www.firecrawl.dev/app/api-keys) when you need higher limits.
